Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Flighty's PRO pricing screen - an independently swipeable feature carousel on top and a pinned subscription card below, each feature page recoloring the header.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
A paywall split in two zones: a top feature carousel (Live Activities, Watch Complications, Lock Screen Widgets, Unlimited Historical Flights, Sync Your Life, Best-in-Class Alerts, Delay Forecast, Live Weather Radar, 25h Where's My Plane) with a product visual and caption per page, and a bottom subscription card ("BEST VALUE", "Unlimited Annual", per-month price, Continue button) that stays put.

## Motion spec
Pattern: independent dual carousels.
- The feature carousel pages horizontally, 1:1 swipe with snap (spring ~340/26); each page's illustration parallaxes (moves at 0.85x drag speed) against its gradient backdrop.
- Each page carries its own header gradient (purple-magenta variants): the background crossfades to the new page's gradient (350ms) during the swipe, driven by drag progress, not after snap.
- Captions ("Expect low-hassle, Pain accordingly"-style one-liners) fade/slide in after the snap (translateY 8px, 200ms).
- The bottom plan card never moves with the carousel; if multiple plans exist they swipe in their own independent horizontal track with the same snap physics, and the price/month text rolls vertically on change (180ms).
- Continue button: press squash (scale 0.96, spring ~480/24); loading state swaps the label for a spinner inside the button (no layout shift).
- The "Flighty PRO" header and close X stay pinned above everything.

## Calibration
- Carousel and plan track must never gesture-lock each other: a vertical touch on the card scrolls plans, a horizontal touch on the visual pages features.
- Gradient crossfade tracks drag continuously - half-swiped shows a half-blended gradient.

## Reduced motion
Pages snap without parallax; gradients crossfade post-snap.

## Don't miss
- The feature visual is a device-context mock (watch face, lock screen, widget) - not abstract icons.
- "BEST VALUE" tag and per-month pricing hierarchy stay fixed while features change above.
